purpose: Measure how often natural shops contain a concretely executable two-to-several-action gain immediately before the original actor refreshes or ends recruitment. Candidate generation is generic over purchases, play, choice, magnetization and optional resale, without naming any card or tribe.
cohort: 128 fresh v14 natural parent seeds 91200000..91200127, shadow probes only. T7..12 first end and first refresh per turn with at least 15 remaining native actions. Probe every legal unfrozen purchase. Keep existing hand assets, existing board identity/order, keywords and nondecreasing current and permanent stats, health, armor and next-turn counter resources. Two independent reseeded simulation streams must both accept the same purchase and keep/resell plan. Counts are potential opportunities; there is no rank benefit claim.
screen: Before a refresh require nonnegative net gold and no extra occupied board slot. At end a plan may spend otherwise unspent gold. Measure net-positive gold or at least max(8, 5% of original permanent board stats) added permanent power. Separate nonnegative-gold plans and closing expenditures. To test a class in full natural games require 20/128 distinct games and at least three actual source cards. Do not tune these thresholds after opening results.
